'''Nestro''' was the single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Demophon]]. It was home to a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientific enclave which monitored the activity of [[Demophon (star)|Demophon's sun]] in order to warn of impending [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]].<ref name="S" /> It was [[Demophon supernova|destroyed]] along with the rest of the system when its star went supernova.<ref name="BE">{{WEGCite|story=The Beginning of the End|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>
